name: Create Product
description: Register the product code, name, brand, material, dimensions, application, color code, description, and technical specifications.

name: Update Product Information
description: Update product details while controlling changes affecting existing batches and inventory documents.

name: Discontinue Product
description: Prevent the product from being selected in new sales orders while retaining stock and transaction history.

name: Configure Tile Categories
description: Maintain tile types, applications, materials, and dimensions, such as 30 × 30, 40 × 40, and 60 × 60 cm.

name: Configure Packaging Specifications
description: Record pieces per box, area per piece, and area per box for each product.

name: Configure Unit Conversions
description: Define piece, box, and square-meter conversions for each product and identify its base inventory unit.

name: Create Product Batch
description: Record batch number, product code, color code, production date, and manufacturer; validate batch uniqueness.

name: Update Product Batch
description: Modify batch data and retain change history once inventory transactions exist for the batch.

name: View and Trace Product Batch
description: View batch details, storage locations, inventory balances, and associated transaction history.

name: Create Supplier
description: Register supplier name, supplier code, address, telephone number, and contact person.

name: Update Supplier
description: Update supplier details and cooperation status and access related purchasing documents.

name: Create Customer
description: Register customer name, telephone number, contact information, and delivery address.

name: Update Customer
description: Update customer information and view sales order history.

name: Create Storage Location
description: Define area, aisle, rack, location code, and storage capacity within a warehouse.

name: Update Storage Location Status
description: Edit or deactivate a storage location after checking whether any inventory remains there.

name: Create Purchase Order
description: Create a purchase order specifying supplier, products, quantities, units of measure, and expected receipt date.

name: Update or Cancel Purchase Order
description: Amend or cancel a purchase order, subject to validation of quantities already received.

name: Approve Purchase Order
description: Review a purchase order and approve, reject, or return it for revision.

name: Record Supplier Confirmation
description: Record confirmed quantities, shortfalls, and the supplier’s expected delivery schedule.

name: Track Purchase Order Progress
description: Track ordered, confirmed, received, and outstanding quantities.

name: Register Supplier Delivery
description: Receive supplier goods and delivery documents and link them to the corresponding purchase order.

name: Inspect Received Goods
description: Count and verify product, quantity, batch number, color code, production date, and goods condition.

name: Record Receiving Discrepancy
description: Record shortages, over-deliveries, incorrect products or batches, and broken or damaged goods.

name: Create Goods Receipt from Purchase Order
description: Prepare a goods receipt referencing the purchase order and receiving results, with batch, quantity, and stock status.

name: Approve Receiving Discrepancy Resolution
description: Authorize quantities to receive, hold for resolution, or return to the supplier.

name: Confirm Goods Receipt
description: Finalize the goods receipt and increase inventory by product, batch, and stock status.

name: Create Supplier Return Request
description: Request a supplier return referencing the purchase order or receiving record, batch, quantity, and return reason.

name: Approve Supplier Return
description: Review supporting documents and approve or reject a supplier return request.

name: Confirm Supplier Return Dispatch
description: Confirm actual return quantities; reduce stock only when the goods were previously received into inventory.

name: Allocate Storage Locations
description: Allocate newly received goods to storage locations by batch, color code, and quantity after capacity checks.

name: Create Location Transfer
description: Create a transfer document for a batch and quantity between source and destination locations in the same warehouse.

name: Confirm Location Transfer
description: Confirm physical relocation, decrease the source location balance, and increase the destination location balance without changing total stock.

name: Move Goods to Pending Inspection
description: Mark quantities awaiting inspection as unavailable for sales allocation.

name: Record Goods Inspection Results
description: Record inspected, accepted, and rejected quantities and reasons by batch.

name: Approve Release to Available Stock
description: Approve inspection results and release acceptable goods to available inventory.

name: Record and Isolate Damaged Goods
description: Identify affected product, batch, quantity, and location and isolate goods with quality issues.

name: Resolve Isolated Goods
description: Decide whether to reinspect, return to the supplier, or adjust inventory using appropriate documents.

name: View Inventory by Batch and Location
description: View quantities by product, batch, color code, storage location, and stock status.

name: Monitor Available and Reserved Inventory
description: Distinguish physical, available, sales-reserved, and non-issuable stock.

name: Configure and Monitor Low-Stock Alerts
description: Set minimum inventory thresholds and view products below the configured levels.

name: View Inventory Transaction History
description: Trace goods receipts, issues, location transfers, stock-status changes, and inventory adjustments.

name: Create Stocktake
description: Define stocktake scope, schedule, and assigned personnel.

name: Record Stocktake Counts
description: Record physically counted quantities by product, batch, color code, and location.

name: Reconcile Stocktake Variances
description: Compare physical counts with book stock and record discrepancies and their causes.

name: Approve Stocktake Results
description: Review count results and either approve them or request a recount.

name: Confirm Inventory Adjustment
description: Finalize an approved adjustment and update inventory by the correct batch and location.

name: Create Sales Order
description: Create a sales order with customer, products, quantities, units, reference prices, and expected delivery date.

name: Update or Cancel Sales Order
description: Amend or cancel an order while checking previously reserved, issued, or delivered quantities.

name: Allocate and Reserve Stock by Batch
description: Select batches and reserve quantities for an order; indicate when multiple batches are needed.

name: Create Goods Issue Request
description: Create an issue request from a sales order specifying products, quantities, batches, and delivery installment.

name: Approve Goods Issue Request
description: Verify available stock, batches, and requested quantities; approve, reject, or return the request for revision.

name: Pick and Inspect Outbound Goods
description: Pick the approved goods and verify quantities, batches, and color codes before dispatch.

name: Confirm Goods Issue
feature: Goods Issue Management Goods Issue Documents
description: Finalize goods issue, decrease inventory at the correct batch and location, and update quantities issued against the sales order.

name: Create Delivery Batch
description: Define the related issue documents, delivery date, address, recipient, and planned delivery quantities.

name: Confirm Delivery to Customer
description: Record actual delivered quantity, time, recipient, goods condition, and proof of delivery.

name: Handle Short or Failed Delivery
description: Record undelivered quantities and arrange redelivery or return goods to inventory with appropriate documents.

name: Track Sales Order Fulfillment
description: Track ordered, reserved, issued, delivered, and outstanding quantities.

name: Create Customer Return Request
feature: Customer Returns Management Customer Return Requests
description: Create a return request referring to a sales order or goods issue, with product, batch, quantity, and reason.

name: Inspect Customer Returns
description: Inspect returned quantities, batch numbers, color codes, and condition; identify goods eligible for restocking.

name: Approve Customer Return Receipt
description: Approve restockable quantities and the handling of goods that do not meet acceptance criteria.

name: Confirm Customer Return Receipt
description: Finalize the return receipt and update batch-level quantities and inventory status.

name: View Inventory Movement Report
description: Report opening balances, receipts, issues, adjustments, and closing balances by product, batch, and period.

name: View Inventory by Batch and Location Report
feature: Reporting Management Stock by Location Reports
description: Report inventory by batch, location, status, stock age, and products with low or aging stock.

name: View Purchasing and Receiving Report
description: Report ordered, confirmed, received, outstanding, and supplier-returned quantities by supplier.

name: View Sales and Dispatch Report
description: Report ordered, reserved, issued, delivered, and outstanding quantities by product, sales order, and customer.

name: View Stocktake and Adjustment Report
description: Report stocktake outcomes, variances, causes, and adjustment history.

name: Manage Employee Accounts
description: Create, update, and lock employee accounts according to their assigned roles.

name: Configure Roles and Permissions
description: Set access rights for viewing data, creating requests, approving records, and confirming business documents.

name: Configure and Manage Warehouses
description: Maintain warehouse codes, names, addresses, statuses, and responsible personnel for multiple warehouses in one store.

name: Configure Warehouse-Specific Locations
description: Assign each storage location to exactly one warehouse and enforce location-code uniqueness within that warehouse.

name: View Warehouse-Specific and Consolidated Inventory
description: View stock by warehouse, batch, color, location, and status, with consolidated balances across warehouses.

name: Create Inter-Warehouse Transfer Request
description: Specify source warehouse, destination warehouse, batch, quantity, stock status, and reason for the transfer.

name: Confirm Transfer Dispatch
description: Count and issue goods from the source warehouse and place dispatched quantities in in-transit status until received.

name: Confirm Transfer Receipt
description: Compare quantities received with those dispatched and receive goods into the destination warehouse by batch, location, and condition.

name: Reconcile Transfer Discrepancy
description: Record and resolve shortages, surpluses, or damage between transfer dispatch and receipt before closing the transfer.
